title: GM Audio Workbench, Scene Presets & Campaign Preparation
objective: Implement and prove a deterministic GM-facing audio preparation model for workbench drafts, scene presets and campaign preparation over completed AAI-01..07 foundations without creating gameplay truth, widening provider rights or requiring canonical runtime persistence.

workbench.rule: Workbench state is GM-authored presentation/preparation configuration only and cannot create or mutate World, Scene, Event, Combat, Action, Visibility or automation truth.

scene_presets.identity: Stable presetId plus explicit existing owner reference; deterministic authored order then stable entryId.
scene_presets.targets: Existing AAI-02 cueId/soundscapeId references or completed AAI-07 binding definitions only; provider-native identity is never promoted to gameplay truth.
scene_presets.application: Preset application materializes presentation-only preparation output without scene lifecycle or provider transport execution.

preview.rule: Preview produces deterministic non-authoritative preview intents only; actual playback remains governed by completed AAI evidence.

campaign_preparation.rule: Ordered scene presets plus optional GM notes/tags; missing or unavailable audio remains explicit and nonblocking.

persistence.result: No new canonical runtime persistence. Deterministic caller/repository-owned declarative preparation payloads; migration 0022 remains unreserved.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: AAI-08 application PR 334 merged and application main advanced to 45752a7c1bad03b68b275638f4603ca33b8c2ea9 while AIOC still projected AAI-08 in_progress.

changed_since_previous: exact-head Repository Health and bounded AAI-08 Linux/Windows/comparator evidence completed successfully

preserved_boundaries: AAI-08 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority
workbench/preset/campaign preparation cannot create or mutate gameplay truth or scene lifecycle
rights/provenance, capability, terms/entitlement, semantics/runtime, provider restrictions and completed audio evidence remain independent and fail closed
next_action: Completed_verified. Retire AAI-08 implementation authority and select strict successor AAI-09 without starting it implicitly.
